tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor mar nyer mkho'i reg zig bzhugs so// rnal 'byor ma'i zin bris rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob mkhas grub gzhon nu seng ge'i gsung la/ nam mkha' chos bzang dpal gyis zin bris su mdzad par/ mthun rkyen 'dzom zhing gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ skyabs yul bla ma rdo rje chos kyi sku la rigs lnga sogs sangs rgyas dkon mchog thugs rgyud lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos dkon mchog skye mched dang tshigs sogs byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bor bzhugs pa dge 'dun dkon mchog go /skyabs sems dmigs pa skor gcig yig brgya spyi mthun maṇḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyogs gcig tu mdzad par/ sngar gyi skyabs 'gro'i yul de nyid rang gi spyi bor bsgom de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs te/ de la thim par bsam/ yid rtse gcig tu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus gsol ba gdab/ maṇḍal ci 'grub/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsgom la dbang bzhi blangs/ bla ma rang la bstim/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar baṃ/ grwa drug la dga' ba 'khyil ba re re/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rgyu bskyed rim/ 'bras bu rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po la gsum/ rim gyis gsal gdab pa dang / nga rgyal la bslab pa dang sems 'dzin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ snying ka'i chos 'byung gi baṃ yig de phus btab pa bzhin je cher song nas mthar yangs shing rgya che bar bsgom/ rgyud gzhan du swa bha wa bshad pa'i dod/ de'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las pad zlar ro/ /rgyan med/ rgyan can no/ /zhag bdun bdun nas dmigs pa spro'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi skabs su rje btsun gyi 'khrid yig tu nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi thig le dbus su bsgom par bshad kyang /

de ni man ngag gab pa yin gyi/ drod skyed pa'i gdams ngag yin pas me rlung dbus su bsgom gsung ngo / /rlung kha sbyar la lag pa g.yon pas phreng ba bzung / g.yas se gol lo/ /'di rnams zhag bdun ma mtha' 'o/ /gang yi thig le la ge'i dmigs pa dor la/ haṃ kṣ+yaṃ sogs 'bar 'dzag dmigs bskor gcig re re/ gzhan la ston pa'i tshe dmigs thun re re'i mgor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa bsgom/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyi spyod lam rnams byed do/ /goms nas thun gcig la dmigs pa rnams bskyang ba yin no/ ༈ /go snyod/ dbyer ma/ 'u su gsum bsres ba la spod/ cong zhi bre gsum/ nas sngon rjen phye bre gsum/ sran ma bre gang / gro bre phyed/ yungs kar phul gang / 'bras phye phul gang / zhib btags rang 'thag mig nas 'don/ yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /tshogs sgom pa'i gsung la mnyam gzhag snying po rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris mdzad par/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then pas 'og sgo'i rlung gis sum mdo'i ma sbar bas lte ba'i aṃ yang mer 'bar/ me des dbu ma cha phra nas kha ma phyed rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin yin pas kha ma phyed/ g.yas ro ma me'i rang bzhin dang nus pa sdongs/ rengs zhes pa gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bag la zha dang bcas pa rengs bar byed/ 'byer bar byed/ skrag par byed pa yin gsung / mthar sangs rgyas na'ang 'di bzhin sangs rgyas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal gdams thun mong gi dngos grub/ grub chen bcu dang phra mo brgyad ni/ tshe sgrub rdo rje chu 'thung dang / bcud len/ /thig le 'dzag med lte bsgyur dang / /rlung gi bcud len 'chi bslu dang / /dbang bsdud 'di bde bskyed dbang bsdud gnyis nad grol gdon grol dang / /nor sgrub skye ba brtag pa'o/ /phra mo brgyad ni gza' rigs bsrung dang bgegs rigs bsrung /

/rkyal pa kha bcu rab rib gsal/ /dag pa gsal dang snying rlung gsal/ /sngar med gtum mo'i drod spel dang / /dge dang mi dge'i ltas brtag pa'o/ /lam sbas bshad kyi thun mong gi gdams pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang rnal 'byor ma'i zin bris su chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis smras pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rnal 'byor mar nyer mkho'i reg zig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
